snippet.title: LIMINAL SORTING – Official Announcement Trailer | Cozy Organizing Game
snippet.description:
WISHLIST LIMINAL SORTING ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5088450/LIMINAL_SORTING/

Sort more than 6,000 objects inside a mysterious liminal world.

Liminal Sorting is a relaxing organizing simulator that combines the satisfaction of putting everything in its perfect place with strange rooms, unsettling discoveries, timed challenges, and moments of suspense.

Explore mysterious environments, complete enormous collections, unlock powerful sorting abilities, and uncover the secrets hidden throughout this peculiar place.

And whatever you do, don’t trust that cat.

FEATURES:

Sort more than 6,000 objects
Explore mysterious liminal environments
Unlock powerful sorting abilities
Complete relaxing and satisfying collections
Take on timed challenges and minigames
Discover hidden rooms and strange secrets
Enjoy a peaceful experience with moments of suspense

Liminal Sorting is coming soon to PC via Steam.

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5088450/LIMINAL_SORTING/

Developed by Silly Cat
